title: IVG Savr 3000 Cherry Ice Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Ice IVG Savr 3000 Prefilled Pods deliver a clean and punchy Cherry flavour with a bright Menthol exhale. The fruit hits up front with a juicy sweetness, followed by a brisk, icy finish for a fresh and easy vape. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 4ml refill reservoir. Once clicked into place, the refill unit automatically supplies the pod with e-liquid as you vape, offering up to 3000 puffs without needing to refill or replace coils. How to Set Up IVG Savr Prefilled Pod's Step 1: Unpack the Device Remove the cap from the mouthpiece. Take out the silicone stopper from the pod. Step 2: Prepare the Refill Peel off the red sticker. Remove the rubber stop. Step 3: Connect the Pod Align the refill with the pod. Press until you hear a click. Step 4: Insert into Device Slide the full pod-and-refill unit into the Savr device. Step 5: Prime the Coil Wait a few minutes to let the coil fully saturate. ✅ Ready to Vape! Inhale to activate and enjoy.
